name: Universal Cables Ltd
tagline: Power/EHV cable manufacturer riding India's T&D and grid-modernisation capex cycle - Q1 FY27 delivered its best-ever quarter (revenue +57.5% YoY, PAT +109% YoY) on a Rs 2,860cr order book, but net debt/EBITDA has risen to ~4.3-4.9x against ROCE that has never cleared 12% in 5 years and interest coverage of just ~1.55x - a confirmed, sharpened balance-sheet risk funding the ongoing Rs 617cr capacity expansion.
business_overview: Universal Cables manufactures power cables including EHV (extra-high-voltage) cables, catering to utilities, industrial and infrastructure customers as part of India's power transmission and distribution build-out. Promoted by Vindhya Telelinks (Birla Corp group).
fundamentals_table: ROCE ~12% (5-yr range 9-12%, never crossed 15%); ROE ~9% (3/5-yr avg ~7%)
FY26 revenue Rs 3,022.67 Cr (+25.5% YoY); Q1 FY27 Rs 945 Cr (+57.5% YoY, record quarter)
Revenue CAGR ~18.74% vs industry median ~4.57%; FY27 guided 25%+
Borrowings Rs 657 Cr(FY23) -> 771(FY24) -> 849(FY25) -> 1,177 Cr(FY26); net debt/EBITDA ~4.3-4.9x; EBIT/interest coverage only ~1.55x; additional Rs 200 Cr NCD raise board-approved
fundamentals_narrative: Universal Cables is growing revenue well above its industry (~18.7% CAGR vs ~4.6% median), consistent with the broader T&D/grid-modernisation and electrification capex cycle, and Q1 FY27 delivered a genuine inflection - record revenue (+57.5% YoY) and PAT (+109% YoY) off a Rs 2,860cr order book including meaningful export orders. But this pass confirms rather than resolves the leverage risk flagged previously: net debt/EBITDA is now quantified at ~4.3-4.9x across two independent sources (worse than the ~4.33x originally estimated on incomplete data), borrowings rose 38.7% YoY to Rs 1,177cr in FY26 alone, and EBIT/interest coverage is a thin ~1.55x. ROCE has never crossed 15% in 5 years (9-12% range) despite the strong top-line growth, and a further Rs 200cr debenture raise is board-approved on top of the existing load to help fund the Rs 617cr capacity expansion (two of four new CCV lines live, remaining two due Aug/Sep 2026). No promoter pledge and no governance red flag were found.
technical_read: Stock at all-time highs (~Rs 1,477-1,492) following a record Q1 FY27 print; not independently charted this pass.
sentiment_summary: No forum thread check performed this pass (deep-dive budget went to filings/financial verification per the assigned scope).
bse_notes: No AVOID/EXCLUDE/HIGH CAUTION trigger found. Vindhya Telelinks (promoter, Birla Corp group) confirmed no share encumbrance for FY26; promoter holding stable at 61.89%. CFO transition (Gopal Agarwal appointed 12-Nov-2025) and a director's age-linked cessation are routine, not governance red flags. No auditor resignation, no SEBI action found.
bull_case: Genuine, confirmed Q1 FY27 inflection: revenue +57.5% YoY, PAT +109% YoY (highest-ever quarterly revenue, Rs 945cr), on a Rs 2,860cr order book incl. ~Rs 485cr booked export orders + Rs 390cr export pipeline; management guides 25%+ FY27 revenue growth
T&D/grid-modernisation capex tailwind is broad-based and multi-quarter, not a one-off - Q4 FY26 was also an all-time-high quarter with PAT margin at a 7-quarter high (6.58%)
Rs 617cr capacity expansion (4 new CCV lines, raised from Rs 550cr) is two-thirds complete; remaining two lines due online by Aug/Sep 2026, which should further support the growth guidance
No promoter pledge; promoter (Vindhya Telelinks/Birla group) holding stable at ~61.89% with confirmed no share encumbrance for FY26
EHV specialty mix plus a growing export book are incremental moves up the value chain versus a pure commodity domestic cable maker
bear_case: Net debt/EBITDA confirmed at ~4.3-4.9x (worse than the ~4.33x originally flagged) against ROCE that has never exceeded 12% in 5 years (9-12% range) - the Coffee-Can persistence check fails on essentially all recent years
EBIT/interest coverage is only ~1.55x - a thin cushion; interest cost rose ~24.5% in H1 even before the incremental Rs 200cr NCD raise is drawn down
Growth and capacity expansion are being funded predominantly by rising debt, not internal accruals - borrowings +38.7% YoY (Rs 849cr -> Rs 1,177cr) in FY26 alone

Cable manufacturing (ex-EHV) remains a largely commoditised, capital-intensive category; industry-wide capacity additions across peers (KEI, Polycab, Apar all expanding) raise a supply-glut risk if the T&D capex cycle normalises 2-3 years out
Valuation (~25.7x trailing P/E) is not demanding on growth alone but does not appear to clearly price the leverage/interest-coverage risk either way
Q1 FY27 PAT figure is inconsistent across sources (Rs 70.14cr per one report vs Rs 37.18cr per another) - unresolved this pass, flagged rather than used uncritically
verdict_headline: Confirmed leverage risk (net debt/EBITDA ~4.3-4.9x, interest coverage just ~1.55x) against ROCE that has never cleared 12% in 5 years, now set against a genuine Q1 FY27 inflection (revenue +57.5%, PAT +109% YoY) on a Rs 2,860cr order book and a capacity expansion nearing completion. four_box 3.0 (analyst_override), thesis_fit 'neither', conviction Medium (verified, not revised).
verdict_reasoning: four_box = 3.0 (tailwind yes - T&D/grid-modernisation and electrification capex cycle; tam yes - large, growing grid-infrastructure and export cable demand; moat weak - EHV specialty mix within an otherwise commoditised cable industry; valuation weak). Score >=3.0 technically permits a 10x/100x label, but at ~25.7x trailing P/E on a mid-cap already carrying material, still-rising leverage, the return-magnitude math does not support it - analyst_override kept, thesis_fit 'neither'.

This pass confirms (does not just repeat) the leverage flag: net debt/EBITDA is ~4.3-4.9x across two independent sources (up from the ~4.33x originally estimated on incomplete data), borrowings rose 38.7% YoY to Rs 1,177cr in FY26, and EBIT/interest coverage is only ~1.55x - a genuine, quantified balance-sheet risk, not a data gap.

Simultaneously, Q1 FY27 is a real, confirmed inflection (best-ever quarter, PAT +109% YoY) riding a Rs 2,860cr order book and a capacity expansion two-thirds complete. The small/mid-cap live-inflection consideration was weighed, but conviction is held at Medium (not raised) given the leverage risk is worsening in parallel with the growth, not resolving alongside it.
No promoter pledge; no auditor resignation; no SEBI action; no red flag triggered.

four_box.note: T&D capex tailwind and TAM are genuine and now confirmed by a record Q1 FY27 print, but a commoditised product category (moat weak despite EHV specialty mix) and confirmed high leverage (~4.3-4.9x net debt/EBITDA, ~1.55x interest coverage) against ROCE that has never cleared 12% mean the growth math does not support a 10x/100x label even though the score permits one.

earnings_quality.normalised_note: FY26 EBITDA margin of 9.6% is above the trailing 5-yr band (historically ~8-8.5%); part of this is cyclical T&D-capex-cycle strength rather than fully structural, so a normalisation of grid capex spend could compress margins back toward the historical level.

growth_trajectory.last_quarters_note: YoY revenue growth oldest->newest: ~22.7% (Q1 FY26), ~27.6% (Q2 FY26), ~24.7% (Q4 FY26, then an all-time-high quarter), then a sharp step-up to +57.5% (Q1 FY27, Rs 945cr, highest-ever quarterly revenue) on export order execution.
growth_trajectory.reverse_pe_note: At ~25.7x trailing P/E, an ~18-20% EPS CAGR would be a fair ask off a steady-state exit multiple; Q1 FY27's 91-109%-range PAT growth and 25%+ FY27 revenue guidance run well ahead of that, but it is one quarter, not yet a multi-quarter pattern, and rides on debt-funded capacity.

management_quality.capital_allocation: Reinvesting heavily in capacity (Rs 617cr programme, raised from Rs 550cr) funded largely by rising debt (borrowings +38.7% YoY to Rs 1,177cr in FY26, with a further Rs 200cr NCD raise approved) against ROCE that has not exceeded 12% in 5 years - capital intensity is high relative to demonstrated returns, though the current expansion has not yet had a chance to prove itself.
management_quality.capability_ladder_note: EHV facility upgrade (Rs 73cr, Satna) and a growing export order book (~Rs 485cr booked + Rs 390cr pipeline) point toward higher-voltage/higher-value cable segments and export markets, not just commodity domestic LT/MT cable.
